notes.reasoning: Checked date and source release: 'Lozenge of Love' appears on the My Iron Lung EP/single released October 1994, as a B-side on the first CD. Confirmed. 'Jangly, almost sunny' is subjective (sources actually call it dark), but not a factual assertion.

evidence.snippet: My Iron Lung is Radiohead's third EP, released in October 1994 ... compiling songs that were issued as B-sides on two separate CD singles
Lozenge of Love is an obscure part of the My Iron Lung EP ... Featuring just Thom and Jonny, it is a ... acoustic guitar-driven workout.

notes.title: True Love Waits - Live in Oslo
notes.note: The version that circulated on bootlegs for 20 years before the studio take ever existed.
notes.reasoning: Checked the historical gap claim: 'True Love Waits' was first performed in December 1995, became a heavily bootlegged live favourite, and only received a studio release in 2016 on A Moon Shaped Pool — a ~21-year gap, consistent with 'circulated for 20 years before the studio take'. The Oslo live take exists and is the version issued on I Might Be Wrong: Live Recordings (2001), so attribution is real; minor imprecision is that this particular Oslo recording was officially released in 2001 rather than only bootlegged.

evidence.snippet: Radiohead first performed it in 1995, with the singer, Thom Yorke, on acoustic guitar ... released on their ninth album, A Moon Shaped Pool (2016)
